text:
A shooting star flares up in the sky.
You try to make a wish but your
thoughts are ominous. Save vs. L2
Fear. If you fail, lose 1 Sanity and
have -1 to Attack and Defense rolls
for your next combat. If you
succeed, carry on as normal.

zh-CN.title: 7 - 不祥之星
text: 一颗流星划亮天空。你试着许愿，心中却尽是不祥的念头。进行一次L2恐惧防御检定。失败则失去1点理智，并在接下来一场战斗中攻击和防御检定均-1。成功则照常继续。
